title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Physical Infrastructure - Location
description: A location with additional contact attributes as requested in the context of the Plataforma SIMPLE (simple-pi:Location, SIMPLE extension to the FEDeRATED Physical Infrastructure ontology). NOTE: the SIMPLE ontology declares this class as rdfs:subClassOf the base ontology's pi:Location, but no class of that name exists anywhere in the base FEDeRATED PhysicalInfrastructure ontology (checked directly, including its last version before removal from the source repository) -- a dangling reference in the source document, not resolved by guesswork here. A handful of schema:Place-domain properties from the base ontology are still included below as optional, clearly-flagged additions, since SIMPLE's own Location is explicitly location-typed and the base ontology's own location-role/identifier properties target schema:Place -- but this is this candidate's own inference, not something the source document itself asserts.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Location'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

address.description: Property. schema:address. Physical address of this location. Required: the SIMPLE ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Location.

email.description: Property. schema:email. Contact email address for this location. Required: the SIMPLE ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Location.

telephone.description: Property. schema:telephone. Contact telephone number for this location. Required: the SIMPLE ontology asserts a minimum-cardinality-1 restriction on this property for Location.

locode.description: Property. pi:locode (base ontology, domain schema:Place, subPropertyOf schema:identifier -- see the class-level note on the unconfirmed schema:Place lineage). The UN/LOCODE of this location, when it corresponds to a schema:City or schema:Country.

hasLocationRole.description: Relationship. pi:hasLocationRole (base ontology, domain schema:Place -- see the class-level note). The role(s) this location plays in the context of a logistics event. Range: LogisticRoles:LocationRoles, modeled in this repository's separate simple-federated-logisticroles candidate.

geonamesReference.description: Relationship. pi:geonamesReference (base ontology, domain schema:Place -- see the class-level note). Reference to a GeoNames feature corresponding to this location. Range: geonames:Feature (out of scope of this candidate).

containedInPlace.description: Relationship. schema:containedInPlace (base ontology, domain schema:Place -- see the class-level note). The basic containment relation between this location and another place that contains it.

containsPlace.description: Relationship. schema:containsPlace (base ontology, domain schema:Place -- see the class-level note; inverse of containedInPlace). The basic containment relation between this location and other places it contains.
